selectionNote: Selected 10 guided Bangkok d343 products with live public USD From prices (From$, From US$, or FromUSD), combined ratings, and unique 674x446 heroes. The live catalog supports far more than 20 tours, including additional Grand Palace, dinner-cruise, tuk-tuk, floating-market, cooking, and private-driver SKUs, but Viator DataDome blocking plus geo-currency dumps (JPY/EUR/GBP/AUD/CAD/SGD/ZAR/DKK) blocked many otherwise-strong pages from being verified in USD on a complete product page. No live d343 helicopter, stargazing, or guided-hiking page with combined USD+rating+hero was captured. Did not force audio/self-guided/app tours, inactive products, thin-review SKUs, near-duplicates, or products with unusable heroes. Same completeness constraint documented on Kyoto (14), Tokyo (11), Lima (9), Cabo San Lucas (14), Puerto Vallarta (10), Cancun (13), and Mexico City (11).
